scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Do you have business with me?
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
你有事找我吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipments
scripts.translation: 升级装备

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
I came to the ruined village,
looking for some materials. Touched some strange light, and now I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
我原本是到废弃村庄找材料的，不小心碰到一道怪光，就到这里来了。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
I've decided to stick around for a little while. Figured I'd be safe so long as I stay close to this soldier.
I have a proposition for you. I want some materials that can only be found in this place.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
我打算在这里待一阵子，靠着这位士兵，应该挺安全。
我有笔买卖想跟你谈谈，需要你帮我找些只有这里才有的材料。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Get them for me, and I'll improve your equipment in exchange. Just so you know, I can only improve certain types.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
替我弄到它们，作为交换，我会帮你提升装备。不过先说好，我只能提升特定类型的装备。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
If you're interested, we can discuss the details of our bargain.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
如果你感兴趣，我们可以谈谈这笔交易的具体细节。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Make sure ^0000FFyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
That's the minimum requirement for my upgrade service to have any visible effects on your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
装备拿来之前，得先^0000FF精炼到+9或以上^000000。
不达到这个要求，我的手艺就发挥不出效果。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Make sure you're ^0000FFequipped with the item that you want to improve.^000000
Otherwise, I can't evaluate its condition.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
请先^0000FF穿戴好你想升级的装备^000000，否则我没法查看它的状况。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
In other words, ^0000FFIt'll lose its current refining levels, cards and enchantments.^000000
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
你可能已经猜到了，经过这个过程后，你的装备会变成全新的东西。
换句话说，^0000FF它将失去当前的精炼等级、卡片和附魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
And I need ^0000FFIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
Pick an item you want and I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation:
[宝石切割师]
而且，我需要^0000FF幻影石和其他一些材料^000000来升级你的装备。
选一件你想要的物品，我会告诉你我需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Adventurer, do you have ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000? If you have a ^0000cdweapon, a piece armor^000000, or ^0000cdan accessory at Refining Level 9 or higher^000000, 
then I can exchange it for something better at the cost of some Illusion Stones and other materials.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
冒险者，你有^0000cd幻影石^000000吗？
带来^0000cd武器、防具^000000或^0000cd饰品，精炼等级达到+9或以上^000000，再加些幻影石和其他材料，就能换成更好的装备。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
So, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
那么，你想要什么？

scripts.text: Exchange illusion equipment
scripts.translation: 兑换幻影装备

scripts.text: What are Illusion Stones?
scripts.translation: 什么是幻影石？

scripts.text: Can I strengthen the exchanged item?
scripts.translation: 兑换后的物品可以强化吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Use it well and come see me later if you find more Illusion Stones! *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
拿去好好用吧，找到更多幻影石就再来找我！呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
What are ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000, you ask? Well... I don't think anyone knows exactly what they are.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
你问什么是^0000cd幻影石^000000吗？嗯...我想没有人确切知道它们是什么。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
I only know they're rare and can only be found in some special places, and I'm here to collect them for my clients.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
我只知道它们很稀有，只能在某些特殊的地方找到，而我在这里是为了替我的委托人收集它们。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
My clients want to figure out what these stones are. They're paying me a lot of money,
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
委托人想弄清这些石头的秘密，为此付了我一大笔钱...

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
so I could offer adventurers like you ^0000cdexpensive equipment in exchange for the stones^000000, and still fetch a profit.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
所以，就算用^0000cd昂贵的装备跟你们冒险者交换这些石头^000000，我也还有得赚。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Bring ^0000cda piece of refined equipment, Illusion Stones^000000, and various materials that are only found in this place. I'll ^0000cdupgrade the equipment, weapon, armor, or accessory?^000000for you.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
带来^0000cd精炼过的装备和幻影石^000000，再加些只有这里才有的材料，我就能帮你^0000cd升级装备，无论是武器、防具还是饰品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
This benefits both of us. Let me know if you're interested in my proposition.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
互惠互利的买卖，有兴趣就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
So, you want to reinforce the equipment you get. You're thorough. I like that!
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
哦，还想进一步强化换来的装备？
考虑得真周到，我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
A while ago, an adventurer who passed through this place told me that a chemist in Prontera refines the Illusion equipment in exchange for Illusion Stones.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
前阵子有位路过的冒险者说，普隆德拉有个化学家，收取幻影石帮人精炼幻影装备。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
It seems Illusion Stones are a popular topic everywhere. Everyone wants to know about what they are.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
看来幻影石到处都很热门。大家都想知道它们到底是什么。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
If you want to refine your equipment, then go to the <NAVI>Illusion Enchanter<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI> near the Town Office.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
想精炼装备，就去找城镇办事处附近的<NAVI>幻觉附魔师<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Did you find anything you liked? If you need anything, please let me know at any time.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
找到喜欢的东西了吗？
有什么需要，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
Ah, Illusion Stones are truly mysterious...
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
啊，幻影石真是神秘莫测...

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipments
scripts.translation: 升级装备

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
I'm here to find some Illusion Stones that I need for my research.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
我来这里是为了寻找我研究所需的幻影石。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
This cave is very mysterious, but I'm not strong enough to explore it by myself.
If you go in there, could you procure some things for me?
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
这个洞穴非常神秘，但我实力不够，无法独自探索。
如果您进去的话，能帮我收集一些东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
In exchange, I'll improve your equipment.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
作为交换，我会改良您的装备。
您觉得如何？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
Make sure ^4d4dffyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
Make sure you're ^4d4dffequipped with the item that you want to improve^000000.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
拿来之前，请先^4d4dff将装备精炼至+9或以上^000000，并^4d4dff穿戴好您想升级的装备^000000。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
In other words, ^4d4dffit'll lose its current Refining and Upgrade levels.^000000
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
升级后，装备会变成全新的形态。
也就是说，^4d4dff原有的精炼和升级等级都会消失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
And I need ^4d4dffIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
Pick an item you want. I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
升级您的装备需要^4d4dff幻影石和其他一些材料^000000。
请选择您想要的物品，我会告诉您需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
It's just hard to get..
scripts.translation:
[幻觉石研究员]
只是很难弄到...

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 负重过高了，得先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Oh, do you have Illusion equipment?
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
哦，您有幻影装备吗？

scripts.text: No. I don't even know what Illusion equipment is.
scripts.translation: 没有，幻影装备是什么？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Oops, I'm sorry. I should've introduced myself first.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
哎呀，抱歉。我应该先自我介绍的。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I'm a chemist specializing in the study of Illusion Stones, which have been circulating among adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
我是化学家，专门研究最近在冒险者之间流传的幻影石。

scripts.text: Illusion Stones?
scripts.translation: 幻影石？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You don't know, don't you? They're the hottest trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您不知道吗？那可是最近最热门的话题。

scripts.text: I don't care about trends.
scripts.translation: 我对潮流不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You must have heard about the strange places that have sprung up here and there lately. Illusion Stones are only found in those places,
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您应该听说过，最近各地突然出现了一些奇怪的地方吧？
只有在那里才能找到幻影石...

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
and their atomic structure is unlike any mineral I've seen. *Blah Blah* ...Their chemical chains... *Blah Blah*
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
它们的原子结构与我见过的任何矿物都不同。
叽里咕噜...化学链...叽里咕噜...

scripts.text: (Uh-oh, he's zoning out!)
scripts.translation: (糟糕，他走神了！)

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Anyway, I can enchant equipment that is exchanged for or purchased with Illusion Stones. I call them the Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
总之，我可以为用幻影石交换或购买的装备进行附魔。我称之为幻影装备。

scripts.text: (He has no sense when it comes to names.)
scripts.translation: （他起名字可真没天分。）

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment at least responds positively to Illusion Stones, or it has the potential to be enchanted successfully.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
这些装备至少对幻影石有积极的反应，或者具备成功附魔的潜力。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Explore the worlds of illusions, collect Illusion Stones, and exchange them for equipment. I can enchant the equipment for you.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
去探索幻影世界，收集幻影石，兑换装备吧。
之后我就能为这些装备附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This benefits both of us. I need Illusion Stones for my studies, and you need powerful equipment for your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
这对我们双方都有利。我需要幻影石进行研究，而您需要强大的装备来冒险。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
That said, my service is not for free. It requires a few Illusion Stones and Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
不过，我的服务不是免费的。这需要一些幻影石和Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I can enchant Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
我可以为幻影装备进行附魔。

scripts.text: How much do you charge?
scripts.translation: 收费多少？

scripts.text: Add stats to Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 为幻影装备附加属性

scripts.text: Reset enchanted Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 重置幻影装备的附魔

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
First, let me tell you that I can only enchant certain types of Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
首先，我要告诉您，我只能为特定类型的幻影装备进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Up to 2 sockets can be enchanted, and enchanting each socket requires 5 Illusion Stones. You can reset enchanted Illusion equipment at any time.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
最多可以附魔2个插槽，每个插槽需要5块幻影石。您可以随时重置幻影装备的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Enchanting never fails, but resetting sometimes failes. Even modern science can't change that.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
附魔永远不会失败，但重置有时会失败。即使是现代科学也无法改变这一点。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Resetting requires a different amount of Zeny depending on the success chance you choose. Select the menu if you'd like to see the available payment options.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
重置费用随您选择的成功率而变化。
想了解具体费用，打开菜单看看就知道了。

scripts.text: Right-handed Weapon
scripts.translation: 右手武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Shoes
scripts.translation: 长靴

scripts.text: Garment
scripts.translation: 披肩

scripts.text: Right Accessory
scripts.translation: 右侧饰品

scripts.text: Left accessory
scripts.translation: 左侧饰品

scripts.text: Helm (Upper)
scripts.translation: 头饰（头上）

scripts.text: Left-handed Weapon/Shield
scripts.translation: 左手武器/盾牌

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You must be equipped with an item in the selected location to have it enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您必须在选定的位置装备物品才能对其进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment is not from a world of fantastic illusions. I'm offended that you even showed it to me.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
这可不是幻影世界的装备，居然拿这种东西给我看，真让人生气。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Random options are checked for that equipment. The equipment cannot be enchanted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000检测到该装备带有随机属性，无法进行附魔。^000000

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This is the best of all Illusion equipment. There's no technology available in this day and age that can enchant it. Even the most skilled enchanter can't do that.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
这已经是幻影装备中的极品了，以当今的技术，哪怕最厉害的附魔师也没法再为它附魔。

scripts.text: [Illusion Enchanter]
scripts.translation: [幻影附魔师]

scripts.text: This is the best of all Illusion equipment. There's no technology available in this day and age that can enchant it. Even the most skilled enchanter can't do that.
scripts.translation: 这已经是幻影装备中的极品了，以当今的技术，哪怕最厉害的附魔师也没法再为它附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Well, not unless he's willing to risk his mental and physical health.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
除非他愿意冒着精神和身体健康的风险。

scripts.text: [Illusion Enchanter]
scripts.translation: [幻影附魔师]

scripts.text: Well, not unless he's willing to risk his mental and physical health.
scripts.translation: 除非他愿意拿自己的身心健康冒险。

scripts.text: [Illusion Enchanter]
scripts.translation: [幻影附魔师]

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
But who knows? Maybe someday you'll meet someone who is talented enough to handle this precious equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
但谁知道呢？也许有一天，您会遇到一位才华横溢的人，能够驾驭这件珍贵的装备。

scripts.text: But who knows? Maybe someday you'll meet someone who is talented enough to handle this precious equipment.
scripts.translation: 不过，谁知道呢？也许有一天你会遇到一位有本事处理这件珍贵装备的人。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment is already enchanted to the maximum limit.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
这件装备的附魔已达到上限。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
What kind of effect would you like to add?
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您想添加什么效果？

scripts.text: Melee
scripts.translation: 近战

scripts.text: Ranged
scripts.translation: 远程

scripts.text: Magic
scripts.translation: 魔法

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I'll try to enchant the first ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[幻影附魔师]
我会尝试为您的装备附加第一项属性。^ff0000现有精炼等级和卡片不会受到影响。即使尝试失败，装备也不会损坏。^000000要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I'll try to enchant the second ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[幻影附魔师]
我会尝试为您的装备附加第二项属性。^ff0000现有精炼等级和卡片不会受到影响。即使尝试失败，装备也不会损坏。^000000要继续吗？

scripts.text: [Illusion Enchanter]
scripts.translation: [幻影附魔师]

scripts.text: I'll try to enchant the first ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 我会尝试为您的装备附加第一项属性。^ff0000现有精炼等级和卡片不会受到影响。即使尝试失败，装备也不会损坏。^000000要继续吗？

scripts.text: I'll try to enchant the second ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 我会尝试为您的装备附加第二项属性。^ff0000现有精炼等级和卡片不会受到影响。即使尝试失败，装备也不会损坏。^000000要继续吗？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
没问题。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

scripts.text: [Illusion Enchanter]
scripts.translation: [幻影附魔师]

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This item requires 5 {0}, and you don't have all that I need from you.
scripts.translation:
[幻影附魔师]
这个物品需要5个{0}，但您没有带齐所需材料。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Only fully enchanted items can be reset. Please enchant it twice, and if you still want to reset it, then bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
只有附魔完成的装备才能重置。
请先完成两次附魔，之后仍想重置，再拿来找我。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Your resetting chance varies, depending on the amount of Zeny you pay. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您的重置成功率取决于您支付的Zeny数量。您想怎么做？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
没问题。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You don't have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[幻觉附魔师]
您的Zeny不足。
